question: Select the most appropriate word to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**minimising**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about the importance of **physical exercise.**
 
• In the given blank '**minimising**' is the correct word.
 
• It means 'to make something as small as possible (in amount or level)'. [(मात्रा या स्‍तर की दृष्टि से) यथासंभव न्‍यूनतम कर देना] 
 
 
• *Example: We shall try to **minimise** the risks to the public.*
 
 
 
• The later part of the sentence is talking about the incidence of heart attacks. Physical exercise reduces heart attacks.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.****
 

Correct Passage:__** *The importance of physical exercise in **minimising** the incidence of heart attacks cannot be under estimated. The rise of heart attacks has been attaining (2)_______ proportion in recent times causing grave concern specially to the medical (3)______. Walking is the best mode of physical exercise which (4) ________ no equipment money, material or (5)______ of a club.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

 
• * *"**maximising**" - This means to make something as large or as much as possible. This option is the opposite of "minimising," and while physical exercise can certainly maximize health and fitness, it doesn't quite fit the context of the sentence which is specifically talking about the incidence of heart attacks.
 
• "**emphasising**" - This means to give special importance or attention to something. This option is the best fit for the sentence because it accurately describes the importance of physical exercise in reducing the incidence of heart attacks. By emphasizing the role of physical exercise, people may be more likely to prioritize it in their lives and reduce their risk of heart attack.
 
• "**increasing**" - This means to make something more or to cause something to grow. While regular physical exercise can certainly increase fitness and overall health, this option doesn't fit the context of the sentence which is focused on reducing the incidence of heart attacks.
